chigger.definition:
n small tropical flea; the fertile female burrows under the skin of the host including humans
n larval mite that sucks the blood of vertebrates including human beings causing intense irritation
chigger.translation:
n. 恙螨
[医] 恙螨, 沙螨, 沙虱, 恙虫

chigre.definition:
n. A species of flea (Pulex penetrans), common in the West
   Indies and South America, which often attacks the feet or any exposed
   part of the human body, and burrowing beneath the skin produces great
   irritation. When the female is allowed to remain and breed, troublesome
   sores result, which are sometimes dangerous. See Jigger.
